backend: private headless Aqueous on real AMD GPU

gtk_review.conclusion: No verified upstream fix matching the reported artifact identified in reviewed changes. Full redraw bypasses node differencing; it does not identify the defective layer.

limitations: Affected GPU model, installed versions, scale and access not supplied.
Headless tests do not exercise physical DRM/KMS scanout.
Local Aqueous binaries predate current source HEAD; binary hashes recorded instead of claiming source equivalence.
Before/after comparisons sample the left panel, not every intermediate animation frame.
Baseline hover cross-run comparison differs around active workspace button; before/after within each run is exact. Title/opacity comparisons should be used for partial-vs-full equivalence.
Vulkan validation requested only for fractional GTK clients, not compositor. A deprecated layer-setting warning was emitted; no VUID or sync hazard appeared.
next_required: Reproduce on affected hardware/software; capture client damage and compositor output, isolate node diff versus buffer preservation versus output damage, then patch the responsible component and verify with partial redraw enabled.

runs.description: Fresh private browser profiles; native Wayland; animated canvas and 90 short/long/Unicode title changes; Pearl Vulkan partial versus full redraw; 45 percent panel background opacity.
limitations: No video decoding, HDR, tab switching, fullscreen or browser overlap beneath panel exercised.
Different clock widths between cases preclude claiming full-panel cross-run pixel equivalence.

firefox_research.user_observation: Seems to occur only with Firefox Developer Edition.
firefox_research.assessment: A real Wayland borrowed-texture ownership fix, but no evidence it explains this report. Tested Developer Edition 159.0b1 is newer.
needed_from_affected_system: Firefox version and about:support Graphics section
Artifact location: Pearl panel versus Firefox content versus multiple windows
Exact triggering action/page; whether video, fullscreen or tab changes are involved
